meta.name: design-tokens
meta.description: Generate OR consolidate design tokens — type scales, color palettes, spacing systems, dark-mode derivations with WCAG checks (generate); or audit-and-reduce an over-grown Tailwind v4 token set with identical render (consolidate). Outputs CSS/Tailwind. Triggers "design tokens", "type scale", "color palette", "theme setup", "reduce tokens", "dedupe tokens", "too many tokens", "consolidate tokens".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成并整合设计令牌，输出CSS或Tailwind样式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要创建或优化设计系统中的令牌集
copy.tagline_en: Generate and consolidate design tokens, outputting CSS or Tailwind styles
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create or optimize token sets in a design system

howto.what: Claude 会根据你的需求生成或整合设计令牌，包括字体大小、颜色、间距、暗黑模式等，并确保符合 WCAG 无障碍标准，最后输出 CSS 或 Tailwind 代码。
howto.when: 当你提到“设计令牌”、“调色板”、“字体比例”、“主题设置”、“减少令牌”等关键词，或者要求设置设计系统时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一个以蓝色为主色的调色板，包含深浅色阶。
say.note: Claude 会生成颜色令牌并检查对比度。

say.text: 我项目里的 Tailwind 令牌太多了，帮我整理一下。
say.note: Claude 会审核并合并重复或近似的令牌。

say.text: 生成一个 1.2 倍率的字体比例，基础字号 16px。
say.note: Claude 会输出字体大小令牌。

howto.what_en: Claude generates or consolidates design tokens (type scales, color palettes, spacing, dark mode with WCAG checks) and outputs CSS or Tailwind code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "design tokens", "color palette", "type scale", "theme setup", "reduce tokens", or request design system setup.

say_en.text: Generate a color palette based on blue, with light and dark shades.
say_en.note: Claude creates color tokens and checks contrast.

say_en.text: I have too many Tailwind tokens, please consolidate them.
say_en.note: Claude audits and merges duplicate or similar tokens.

say_en.text: Generate a type scale with ratio 1.2 and base size 16px.
